about: Per resolve class, the largest difference in any channel (0-255) a backend's pixel may show against the reference pixel of that class. All are placeholders until the cross-architecture measurement sets them. Coverage starts at the core's COVERAGE_TO_SAMPLE_LSB, which bounds the coverage resolve against the sample resolve for a pixel with one partial mask or one path edge; a surface's silhouette under a path's edge takes the sample resolve. Measured where pixels switch resolves: worst 1 as a path crosses a moving surface, within 2 where a silhouette, a path edge and a crossing meet.
